title: IAEA Live Chart: 40K half-life 1.248E+9 Y (uncertainty from the seconds column)
summary: The Live Chart row for 40K lists half-life 1.248E+9 with unit Y. The seconds columns fix the absolute uncertainty at 3000000 years.
body: The IAEA Live Chart ground-state row for 40K (Z=19, N=21), extracted 2026-11-18, lists half_life 1.248E+9, unit_hl Y, unc_hl 3, half_life_sec 3.938304361629082e16, and unc_hls 94670777923776. Dividing half_life_sec by half_life gives 31556926 seconds per unit, so unit code Y is years in this row. Dividing unc_hls by that same number gives an absolute uncertainty of 3000000 years. The small integer unc_hl (3) matches that absolute uncertainty as 3 in the last significant place of the printed half-life, not as 3 years on its own. The leading decay field is B- at 89.28 percent. The abundance field is 0.0117 with unc_a 0.0001. The row's ENSDF publication cut-off field is 30-Sep-2015. This is the database row, not a new laboratory measurement made for this card.
